{
  "name": "tiered-bundle-builder",
  "database": {
    "tables": [
      {
        "name": "bundles",
        "purpose": "Stores each bundle's identity, mode (fixed or flexible), enabled state, and a system-managed health status that reflects whether all constituent variants are currently available.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal bundle id" },
          { "name": "title", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "description", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NULL" },
          { "name": "mode", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fixed'", "enum": ["fixed", "flexible"], "purpose": "fixed=predefined set; flexible=customer picks from pool" },
          { "name": "enabled", "sqlType": "BOOLEAN", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT false" },
          { "name": "health_status", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'healthy'", "enum": ["healthy", "warned", "auto_disabled"], "purpose": "merchant-facing health signal" },
          { "name": "created_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" },
          { "name": "updated_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "indexes": [["enabled", "created_at"], ["health_status"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_items",
        "purpose": "Stores the variant-level products belonging to each bundle, including the last-observed availability of each variant so the system can react when Shopify signals a change.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()" },
          { "name": "bundle_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle this item belongs to" },
          { "name": "variant_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the specific Shopify product variant id" },
          { "name": "product_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the parent product of the variant" },
          { "name": "observed_availability", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available'", "enum": ["available", "out_of_stock", "deleted"], "purpose": "last known availability state" },
          { "name": "added_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["bundle_id", "variant_external_id"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "added_at"], ["variant_external_id"], ["product_external_id"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_tiers",
        "purpose": "Stores each discount tier for a bundle, including the minimum item count that qualifies a customer and the discount rate, ordered by the merchant's chosen display sequence.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()" },
          { "name": "bundle_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle this tier belongs to" },
          { "name": "minimum_item_count", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "discount_rate", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "discount rate in basis points (e.g. 1000 = 10%)" },
          { "name": "display_order", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 0" },
          { "name": "created_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" },
          { "name": "updated_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["bundle_id", "minimum_item_count"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "display_order"], ["bundle_id", "minimum_item_count"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_purchase_records",
        "purpose": "Stores a record of every bundle that was present in a paid order, keyed by order external identifier and timestamp so duplicate webhook deliveries produce no duplicate rows.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()" },
          { "name": "bundle_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle that was purchased" },
          { "name": "order_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the paid order that contained this bundle" },
          { "name": "order_placed_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "variant_external_ids", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "comma-separated list of variant ids selected at purchase time" },
          { "name": "item_count", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "discount_rate_applied", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "applied discount rate in basis points" },
          { "name": "order_total", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "order total in minor currency units" },
          { "name": "currency_code", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD'" },
          { "name": "recorded_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["order_external_id", "bundle_id"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "order_placed_at"], ["order_placed_at"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_health_events",
        "purpose": "Logs every automated health change applied to a bundle so merchants can audit why a bundle changed state.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()" },
          { "name": "bundle_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle whose health changed" },
          { "name": "event_kind", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "enum": ["auto_disabled", "warned", "cleared"], "purpose": "the type of health change" },
          { "name": "affected_variant_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NULL", "purpose": "the variant whose availability triggered this change" },
          { "name": "reason", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "occurred_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "occurred_at"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      }
    ]
  },
  "shopifyIntegration": {
    "webhookTopics": [
      "orders/paid",
      "inventory_levels/update",
      "products/update",
      "products/delete"
    ],
    "cronSchedule": "*/10 * * * *"
  },
  "httpRoutes": {
    "admin": [
      { "path": "/bundles", "method": "POST", "purpose": "List bundles paginated, filterable by status." },
      { "path": "/bundles/create", "method": "POST", "purpose": "Create a new bundle." },
      { "path": "/bundles/update", "method": "POST", "purpose": "Update a bundle's title, description, mode, or enabled flag." },
      { "path": "/bundles/remove", "method": "POST", "purpose": "Delete a bundle." },
      { "path": "/bundles/clone", "method": "POST", "purpose": "Clone an existing bundle." },
      { "path": "/bundles/bulk-status", "method": "POST", "purpose": "Bulk enable or disable bundles." },
      { "path": "/bundles/items", "method": "POST", "purpose": "List items for a bundle." },
      { "path": "/bundles/items/save", "method": "POST", "purpose": "Replace the item set of a bundle." },
      { "path": "/bundles/tiers", "method": "POST", "purpose": "List discount tiers for a bundle." },
      { "path": "/bundles/tiers/save", "method": "POST", "purpose": "Replace the tier list of a bundle." },
      { "path": "/purchase-history", "method": "POST", "purpose": "List purchase history records." }
    ],
    "widget": [
      { "path": "/bundle", "method": "POST", "purpose": "Fetch bundle config, tiers, and items for the widget." },
      { "path": "/bundle/validate", "method": "POST", "purpose": "Validate a selection and return the earned tier." },
      { "path": "/cart/add", "method": "POST", "purpose": "Add the validated selection to the cart with discount applied." }
    ]
  }
}
